messages:
amanda: Quick async — we need to lock scope for the next telemetry slice. Focus areas: dashboards (cost + error), tracing hooks for hot paths, and sampling strategy. I want clear launch criteria we can commit to by EOD Fri. Owners?
jordan: I can own dashboards. question: do we surface per-route token cost or just per-model?
ellie: tracing hooks are heavier than they look. adding span tagging in the runtime is ~2 sprint work unless we do a lightweight sampling approach first.
rajesh: Cost-wise: high-cardinality traces + long retention => $$$. We should define retention tiers (7d vs 90d) and a paywall for >30d.
matt: For acceptance, propose 3 dashboards: global cost overview, top-10 routes by p99 latency, and error heatmap by model+route. All should be drillable.
sara: Customer ask (FinTech customer): they want cost-per-customer-by-route for chargeback. That needs attribution — not currently in events.
rana: From SRE: tracing hooks need safe guards. If we enable full traces for prod, add circuit-breaker + rate cap at agent level. Also suggest traffic-scoped canaries.
amanda: Good points. Tradeoffs: full traces = better root cause but high cost/infra. Lightweight spans + deterministic sampling for 95% of traffic, full traces for 0.1% plus configurable on-demand for customer sessions? Thoughts.
jordan: That sounds reasonable. For dashboards, we'll build the drilldowns assuming sampled traces and augment with logs for detailed troubleshooting.
ellie: Implementation note: runtime can emit an enriched header to signal when a request should be fully traced. Need an API from product to mark sessions.
rajesh: We'll need an event to carry "billing_entity" for per-customer cost. That will be an opt-in flag for Dedicated/Private initially. Hosted customers: privacy concerns.
matt: Sampling config proposal (short):
```
- deterministic_sampling: 1/1000 (uniform by request id)
- targeted_hotpath: 5% for routes tagged hot
- debug_full: toggle per-session (admin only)
```
This gives us correlated metrics + occasional full traces.
sara: For the FinTech ask, customer will accept per-customer aggregates (daily cost) if we can't deliver full trace-based attribution in Q1. They need billing-ready numbers by end of Q2.
rana: Launch gating: must have (1) no perf regression on p99 < 20% increase, (2) circuit-breaker + cap enabled, (3) sample config default set to safe values.
amanda: Acceptance criteria I'm proposing:
- Dashboards: global cost, top routes latency, error heatmap + drilldown links to traces/logs.
- Tracing: deterministic sampling + hotpath boost + on-demand session full trace. Runtime headers + API for session marking.
- Cost: per-route token breakdown available, per-customer aggregates for Dedicated only (hosted: anonymized/aggregates).
- Safety: circuit-breaker, rate caps, and test canary in us-west-2 with 1% traffic.
If no objections, owners: jordan (dashboards), ellie (tracing hooks runtime), rajesh (billing events + retention policy), matt (sampling + dashboard metrics), rana (safety + canary).
jordan: I'll draft dashboard mocks and perf budget next week; ETA Wed.
ellie: I'll scope the runtime change — sending a short RFC by Tuesday. If we keep the header API simple we can do the canary quickly.
rajesh: I'll add retention tiers to pricing doc and a bring-up checklist for Dedicated.
matt: I'll own sampling config and provide telemetry queries for dashboards.
sara: I'll align with the FinTech PM and push for a Q2 commitment for aggregates.
amanda: Great. Next steps: owners add one-line acceptance tasks in the shared doc by EOD Thu. We'll reconvene Mon for final sign-off.
deploy-bot: Canary cluster created in us-west-2 for "telemetry-slice-canary" (id: canary-174999).
amanda: Thanks — leaving this async. Ping me if anything blocks.
